mapper.select: SELECT po.ORDER_ID AS orderId, TO_CHAR(po.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orderDateISO, TO_CHAR(po.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS orderDateDisplay, m.MEMBER_NAME AS ordererName, rep.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, rep.QTY AS qty, cnt.PRODUCT_COUNT AS productCount, po.TOTAL_PRICE AS paymentAmount, po.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, d.DELIVERY_STATUS AS deliveryStatus, d.TRACKING_NO AS trackingNo, d.COMPANY AS company FROM PRODUCTORDER po JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = po.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT od.ORDER_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, od.QTY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY od.ORDER_ID ORDER BY od.OD_ID) AS rn FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN OPTIONDETAIL opd ON opd.POP_ID = od.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = opd.PRODUCT_ID ) rep ON rep.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID AND rep.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCT_COUNT FROM ORDERDETAIL GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) cnt ON cnt.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID WHERE po.ORDER_STATUS != 'CART' ORDER BY po.ORDER_ID ASC

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN po.ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAYMENT_WAITING', 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED') AND (d.DELIVERY_STATUS IS NULL OR d.DELIVERY_STATUS != 'CANCELED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newOrders, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.DELIVERY_STATUS = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS preparing, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.DELIVERY_STATUS IN ('SHIPPED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shipped, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.DELIVERY_STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceled FROM PRODUCTORDER po LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID WHERE po.ORDER_STATUS != 'CART'
SELECT po.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, d.DELIVERY_STATUS AS deliveryStatus FROM PRODUCTORDER po LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID WHERE po.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DELIVERY (DELIVERY_ID, ORDER_ID, COMPANY, TRACKING_NO, DELIVERY_STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_DELIVERY_ID.NEXTVAL, #{orderId}, #{company}, #{trackingNo}, #{deliveryStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTORDER SET ORDER_STATUS = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_STATUS = 'PAYMENT_WAITING'
